cd /workspace/task && python3 -c "
import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('init.xlsx')
ws = wb['Sheet1']
# D1: B1='Description A', B2 blank -> 'Single A'
# D5: B5='Description B', B6 blank -> 'Single B'
# D9: B9='Description A', B10='Description B' -> 'Multiple'
# Use formula referencing B and C columns.
# D1: if B1='Description A' and B2 blank -> 'Single A'; if B1='Description B' and B2 blank -> 'Single B'; if B1='Description A' and B2='Description B' -> 'Multiple'
# Generalize: D1 = if B1='Description A' and B2='Description B' -> 'Multiple'; elif B1='Description A' and B2 blank -> 'Single A'; elif B1='Description B' and B2 blank -> 'Single B'
# But the instruction says 'if B1 contains Description A and B2 is blank -> Single A'. Let's write formula.
ws['D1'] = '=IF(AND(B1=\"Description A\",B2=\"Description B\"),\"Multiple\",IF(AND(B1=\"Description A\",B2=\"\"),\"Single A\",IF(AND(B1=\"Description B\",B2=\"\"),\"Single B\",\"\")))'
ws['D5'] = '=IF(AND(B5=\"Description A\",B6=\"Description B\"),\"Multiple\",IF(AND(B5=\"Description A\",B6=\"\"),\"Single A\",IF(AND(B5=\"Description B\",B6=\"\"),\"Single B\",\"\")))'
ws['D9'] = '=IF(AND(B9=\"Description A\",B10=\"Description B\"),\"Multiple\",IF(AND(B9=\"Description A\",B10=\"\"),\"Single A\",IF(AND(B9=\"Description B\",B10=\"\"),\"Single B\",\"\")))'
wb.save('output.xlsx')
print('saved')
"
